name: Cholamandalam Financial Holdings Ltd.
about: Cholamandalam Financial Holdings Limited, an investment company, provides financial services in India. It operates through Financing, Insurance, and Others segments. The company offers vehicle finance, loans against property, home loans, secured business and personal loans, consumer and small enterprises loans, gold loans, and small and medium enterprise loans, as well as various other financial services to customers; and general insurance services, including motor, property and casualty, health, accident, fire and engineering, crop, marine, and travel insurance, as well as reinsurance. It serves first-time borrowers, new to credit customers, and individuals, as well as corporates, small, micro, medium enterprises. The company was formerly known as TI Financial Holdings Limited and changed its name to Cholamandalam Financial Holdings Limited in March 2019. Cholamandalam Financial Holding

verdict.label: Looks cheap
reasons: Price implies only ~-1% a year growth, below the ~25% that history and analysts support, so expectations look modest.
PE of 10 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 16), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 10 vs a quality-and-growth-justified 25 for this sector; cheaper than peers of similar quality.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 25% a year while PE moved 12 → 10.
